page.subtitle: Legal entities, incorporation status as recorded and as verified, and the regulatory, external-party and internal approval register. The platform records specialist assessments with evidence; it never determines them.

entities.name: Legal entity
entities.roleHint: The same entity may take part in several projects with different roles.
entities.createHint: A new entity always starts as Unconfirmed with unknown verification — record its status with evidence afterwards.
entities.empty: No legal entities linked to this project
entities.emptyHint: Record the NewCo status (setup step 2) or add the entities taking part in the transaction.
entities.explain: Incorporation is its own status dimension. Recording or verifying it never changes transfers, operational readiness or the completion of the carve-out.
entities.editHint: Descriptive fields only. The incorporation status changes only through Record status and Verify.
entities.noRequirements: No approvals linked to this entity
entities.managedByOwner: Managed by the project that owns this legal entity: it can be read here, but edits and incorporation records are made in the owning project.

incorporation.title: Incorporation — recorded vs verified
incorporation.hint: A recorded status is a claim. It is verified only when someone other than the recorder confirms it against the linked evidence.
incorporation.evidenceNoteHint: Where the registration record is held. Link the document itself in the evidence panel.
incorporation.effectUnconfirmed: The status is recorded as Unconfirmed; there is nothing to verify until it is recorded with evidence.
incorporation.effectProposed: The status is recorded as {status} and stays Proposed until someone else verifies it.
incorporation.evidenceRule: Incorporated and In progress need active evidence linked to the entity (now: {count}).
incorporation.separate: Transfers, operational readiness and carve-out completion are not changed.
incorporation.rejectTitle: Reject the recorded incorporation status of {name}
incorporation.verifyEffect: The recorded status ({status}) becomes Confirmed against the linked evidence ({count} active).
incorporation.rejectEffect: The status goes back to Unknown verification; the recorder must record it again with better evidence.
incorporation.notSelf: The person who recorded the status cannot verify it.
incorporation.youRecorded: You recorded this status, so another verifier must confirm it.
incorporation.separateNote: Incorporation is verified separately from transfers: a verified incorporation does not mark any asset, contract or employee group as transferred.

dimensions.title: Independent status dimensions
dimensions.hint: Computed by the gates module from the registers and their evidence; never merged into one overall status.
dimensions.carveOutCompleteHint: Never true because a single dimension, such as incorporation, is complete.

setup.title: NewCo status (setup step 2)
setup.hint: Choose the NewCo and its status. "Incorporated" and "In progress" are refused without evidence; when in doubt choose Unconfirmed.
setup.evidenceHint: Where the registration record is held. You can link the document on the entity afterwards.

req.authorityHint: As named in the source; abbreviations are not expanded without confirmation.
req.title: Title
req.gateInvalid: Use a gate key such as G2
req.emptyHint: Legal registers regulatory, external-party and internal approvals here; each starts as "Assessment pending — specialist".
req.explain: Appearing in a source never means an approval is required or obtained. Applicability is a specialist assessment with its basis; an outcome is recorded with evidence and validity by someone other than the registrant.
req.createHint: The entry starts as "Assessment pending — specialist" and Not started.
req.editHint: Descriptive fields only; applicability, status and validity change through their commands.
req.assessEffect: Applicability is recorded as {value} with your basis.
req.assessNotSelf: The person who registered the entry cannot record this.
req.notDetermination: The platform records the specialist's assessment; it does not make the determination.
req.pendingNotice: Assessment pending — specialist. It cannot be submitted or have an outcome recorded until a specialist assesses it as applicable.
req.outcomeEvidence: Needs active evidence such as the licence or decision letter (now: {count}).

effect.start_preparation: The entry moves to In preparation.
effect.submit: The submission to the authority or party is recorded with its date.
effect.withdraw: The entry is withdrawn with your reason.
effect.mark_expired: The entry is marked expired (its validity has ended).
effect.reopen: A new application starts (In preparation), with your reason.
effect.record_grant: The grant is recorded with its decision date and validity.
effect.record_grant_with_conditions: The conditional grant is recorded; its conditions stay open until their satisfaction is evidenced.
effect.record_refusal: The refusal is recorded with its decision date.

req.conditionsEffect: The conditions are recorded as satisfied.
req.conditionsNotSelf: The person who recorded the conditional grant cannot close its conditions.

validityNotice.expiring: The validity ends soon — plan the renewal.
validityNotice.expired: The validity has ended. Mark the entry expired or record a renewal.
